profile_text.body:
Coursera is a public company founded in 2012 and headquartered in Mountain View, California. It trades under the ticker COUR and is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001651562. Its site describes an online learning platform offering courses, Professional Certificates, Specializations, and degrees, with content from organizations and institutions including Google, Meta, Anthropic, DeepLearning.AI, Stanford, and IBM.

According to its own site, Coursera markets these programs as job-aligned, designed with employers and universities to prepare learners for roles in fields such as cybersecurity, UX, data analytics, AI, and business. It highlights named offerings including the Google Project Management Professional Certificate, the Google UX Design Professional Certificate, the IBM Data Science Professional Certificate, the AI Essentials Specialization, the IBM Data Analyst Professional Certificate, the Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate, the Machine Learning Specialization, the Python Specialization, the Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate, the Data Analysis with Python Specialization, and the UI/UX Design Specialization. Coursera Plus is described as an annual subscription giving unlimited access to thousands of courses, Specializations, and Professional Certificates.

The company's own materials also reference generative AI and artificial intelligence courses among its offerings. The record notes a California law exposure count of 281, with no cases listed.
